scoreReasons: AP2 defines no registry, explorer, event stream or .well-known path of its own.
Mandates, receipts and risk_data are private between the parties, and selective disclosure deliberately limits what each sees.
Support is publicly visible only where a UCP merchant lists dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate in /.well-known/ucp.
The specification, schemas and GitHub activity are public, which is how adoption signals can be tracked.

public.how: capabilities list includes dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate; signing keys in keys[].
Commits on main, issues and pull requests; main idle since 2026-04-29.
For example issue 345, which publishes its own /.well-known/ap2.json, a path AP2 does not define.

private.why: Exchanged only between agent, Credential Provider, merchant, processor and network.
Signed JWTs returned to the parties, never published.
Selective disclosure keeps them from verifiers that do not need them.
